summary: CarMax Auto Funding LLC, as depositor and seller, filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $600 million auto-loan asset-backed securitization via CarMax Select Receivables Trust 2026-C. The offered Class A-1 through D notes total roughly $588.2 million at 99.97–100.00 of par, with coupons of 4.262% to 6.03%; the $11.76 million Class E notes at 7.69% are privately placed or retained. Monthly distributions begin October 15, 2026; settlement is on or about September 28, 2026. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
